title: Meet the DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield Team Embracing the Rhythm of Care
summary: Discover how the DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield team ensures a stress‑free trip for working travelers.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Hectic business travelers in India discover a special home base offering warm, thoughtful service that helps them feel at home, even when work takes them far from it.


- **Go behind the scenes with the latest installment of Hilton's Behind the Stay series, spotlighting the remarkable team members whose passion and dedication make Hilton the World's Best Place to Stay.**
- **Discover how the DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield team learns the rhythm of each guest, anticipating needs, adapting to changing schedules and ensuring they enjoy a stress-free trip that allows them to focus on their work.**
- **Meet the amazing people who work across departments to foster a caring environment where both guests and team members feel warmly welcomed and valued.**


In Bengaluru, India, business travelers arrive from different countries, adjust to new time zones and navigate packed schedules filled with work, meetings and airport transfers. Through it all, they discover a welcoming home base in[DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/blrkudi-doubletree-bengaluru-whitefield/) , where they’re greeted with DoubleTree's original, warm chocolate chip cookie, a small gesture that reflects the thoughtful hospitality awaiting them, and a dedicated team that works to make their stay as seamless as possible.


For operations manager Kiran, that commitment to care isn’t just a hospitality philosophy. It’s a core part of the hotel's culture. “Care is a culture that you live by,” she explains, noting that when care comes from the heart, it naturally shines through in the guest experience. The team's goal is simple: take care of the stay – and all the details, big and small - so travelers can focus on their work.


Sometimes, that means stepping in when a guest needs more than a comfortable place to sleep. During an extended business stay, an international guest experienced a medical emergency and required immediate assistance. Front office manager Nikhil and his team took the guest to a nearby hospital, where he was diagnosed with dengue. But the team's care didn’t stop there.


While the guest recovered, team members continued checking on his wellbeing and coordinated with the kitchen to provide appropriate meals. At the same time, they prepared to welcome him back to the hotel.


DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield - Exterior at Night


This rhythm of care is what guests have come to love about staying at DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield. Front office manager Rakesh knows that some guests leave early for work or head straight to the airport, so his team makes sure packed breakfasts are ready for the journey. It is a simple gesture – akin to the warm chocolate chip cookie welcome guests receive upon check-in – but one that leaves a lasting impression.


The spirit of care also extends to the DoubleTree team. Sales manager Sayantan says that feeling accepted by the people around him has transformed the workplace into something that feels like family. Food & Beverage Associates Golla and Elizabeth, who communicate in sign language, describe a workplace where they feel valued and supported. Team members take care of one another, and some have even learned their language, empowering them to extend the same care to guests and give their best.


##### FAQ: Meet the DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield Team Embracing the Rhythm of Care


Hilton team members at DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield help business travelers feel comfortable and cared for, even when navigating long workdays, international travel and changing schedules. The hotel's dedicated team anticipates guest needs, handles the details behind the scenes and adapts to each traveler's rhythm so they can focus on the business that brings them to Bengaluru.


The "rhythm of care" is the DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield team's approach to understanding what guests need, preparing in advance and staying ready to adapt when plans change. From preparing packed breakfasts for guests leaving early for work or the airport to providing support during unexpected situations, the team looks for thoughtful ways to make each stay more seamless and comfortable.


The team demonstrates its commitment to care through both everyday gestures and meaningful support when guests need it most. During one 14-night business stay, an international guest experienced a medical emergency and was diagnosed with dengue. Team members helped take the guest to a nearby hospital, continued checking on their wellbeing, coordinated appropriate meals with the kitchen and prepared to welcome the guest back after recovery.


Care at DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield extends beyond guests to the team itself. Team members describe a workplace where they feel accepted, valued and supported. That culture of care and teamwork helps create a collaborative environment that allows the team to deliver exceptional guest service.


Featured in Hilton's Behind the Stay series, DoubleTree by Hilton Bengaluru Whitefield showcases how a dedicated team can turn Hilton's commitment to hospitality into meaningful guest experiences. By working together across departments, anticipating needs and caring for both guests and one another, the team demonstrates how thoughtful hospitality can make business travel feel more personal.
